Basic Service: A charge to cover costs for meter reading, billing, equipment and maintenance.
This charge is the same regardless of how much energy is used during the billing period.
kWh: The unit of electricity usage meausred by your meter. One kilowatt-hour (kWh) is
1000 watts-hours, and will light a 100-watt bulb for 10 hours. The number of kWhs is
used to determine the electricity charges on your bill.
Delivery: UtilityBill’s charges for bringing electricity from your supplier to your premise,
Electricity Supply: The price of electricity supply used during the billing period.
If you choose an alternate supplier, the price will be what you agree upon with that supplier.
